title: Trigun Maximum
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On the desert planet No Man's Land, Vash the Stampede carries a 60-billion-double-dollar bounty after a city was destroyed by his supernatural power, yet he holds to a vow of pacifism and tries to save every life. In Trigun Maximum, Vash and the gunfighting priest Nicholas D. Wolfwood battle the Gung-Ho Guns assassins serving Vash's nihilistic twin Knives, who seeks to end human life on the planet. Vash ultimately breaks his vow to protect a friend and then saves his brother.
life_message: Every life is worth saving, and love and mercy should hold even against enemies, though the cost of that ideal is real.
